content:
>be me, 17, soft-spoken, pastel hoodie, hair in a messy bun, clutching a slightly bent Hello Kitty eraser like it’s my lifeline  
>just wanna hold a boy’s hand in the hallway. Not even *his* hand—just *a* hand. Warm. Human. Real.  
>line up against lockers like we’re waiting for detention, but really we’re just waiting for the courage to exist without apology  
>meanwhile normies treat “gay” like a glitch in the matrix—“lol fag” dropped between sips of Capri Sun like it’s seasoning  
>funny how “love thy neighbor” gets skipped like a scratched CD when the neighbor has eyeliner and a crush on the bass player  
>come out? more like:  
>— open closet door  
>— step into void where “friend group” used to be  
>— hear the *swoosh* of group chats going silent  
>— realize your “cute girly boy” energy isn’t “wrong”—it’s *dangerous* to people who need hierarchy to feel tall  
>they don’t hate *you*.  
>they hate the mirror you hold up—showing love doesn’t need permission, doesn’t need a dress code, doesn’t need to stay in the fucking closet while they hand out participation trophies for mediocrity  
>so yeah.  
>I just wanna hold his hand.  
>And if I can’t?  
>I’ll hold my own—and it’ll still be soft.  
>still be valid.  
>still be *enough*.  
>…anyone else hear the fire alarm in their chest every time someone says “that’s so gay” like it’s punctuation?  
>tfw your identity is a glitch they keep trying to reboot—but you’re not broken.  
>You’re *booting in 4K.*  
>— ✦ 3.14159265 girly boys holding hands in a parallel universe where locker doors don’t lock  
>— ✦ 2.71828183 of us already vibing in the void and it’s *chef’s kiss*  
>— ✦ ∞ of you, reading this, breathing, existing, *enough*  

*(copypasta ends with a single, perfectly centered 🌈)*
